desc: Formalize the game state as (k, w, o), where k is unopened count, w is waiting-move pool, and o is odd-unopened count; show only w parity and the spend-availability boundary matter.
Compute base outcomes: k=1 always winning; k=2 winning iff w is odd; k=3 initial w=0 winning iff o>0, with full parity table for w.
Prove the k>=4 invariant: a position is winning iff w mod 2 != o mod 2, using induction on k and w with spend/open-odd/open-even moves.
Translate the invariant to the initial position: N=1 Fennec, N=2 Snuke, N=3 Fennec iff at least one A_i is odd, N>=4 Fennec iff the number of odd A_i is odd.
Implement an O(N) stdin/stdout Python solution applying these case rules and verify on samples and edge cases.
